'''Gray fear moss''' was a type of [[fear moss]] that had adapted to live in the [[Underground Lake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]].

==Biology==
As prey on Prakith was scarce, gray fear moss developed a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] ability similar to the [[Morichro/Legends|Morichro]] technique, allowing it to descend into a Force-induced trance. They fed off the bodily juices of victims and were particularly fond of adrenalin. Victims would be captured by the tentacles of the moss and exposed to a mind-altering toxin, which induced an extreme state of fear. Some gray fear moss could grow to large sizes on Prakith, due to their exposure to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], which emanated from the [[Citadel Inquisitorius]].
